messages:
jamie: Morning — quick async standup. Heads-up: us-west2 headroom is thin right now (spare GPUs ≈ 18, 4 reserved for canary). I did a fleet scan and saw 2 nodepools draining + a spike of spot evictions last hour. Blocker: can't get canary to EU until we free up capacity or bump regional buffer. Today I'll try a small prewarm in eu-west1 and open a quick capacity request if autoscaler keeps thrashing.
priya: noted. Do we know which instance types are affected? if it's the T4 pool we can move some low-priority jobs to spot-fallback.
marco: oncall — saw autoscaler thrash around 03:20 UTC, repeated scale-up/scale-down loop. paste of filtered logs below.
marco: ```
2026-02-18T03:20:11Z autoscaler: scaleUp: requested 12 GPUs
2026-02-18T03:20:13Z autoscaler: nodeProvisionFailed: provisioning timeout for id=nodepool-usw2-b
2026-02-18T03:21:05Z autoscaler: scaleDown: removing 4 GPUs (cooldown)
```
liu: looks like the provisioning timeout + spot evictions combo. short-term: reduce per-host concurrency and enable faster fallback to dedicated lanes for production traffic. Also check KV-cache pressure on long-context models — that can blow memory and cause node drains.
rita: @jamie i'll start a capacity ticket (CR-?); can you add the exact nodepool IDs and desired headroom? i can also spin up 8 GPUs in eu-west1 for the canary if we want a quick detour.
jamie: adding nodepool IDs: `us-west2-nodepool-b`, `us-west2-nodepool-c`. target headroom per region = 25% => request +12 GPUs in us-west2, +8 in eu-west1 for canary. will paste the ticket description in a sec.
ops-bot: Alert: Spot eviction wave detected in us-west2 at 03:12 UTC — 9 instances preempted. See incident #INC-20260218-17.
priya: if we request +12 in us-west2, can we prefer non-spot by default? that will cost more but reduce churn. maybe split 8 reserved +4 spot-burst.
marco: +1 to split. also i'll pin the canary traffic to eu-west1 once rita confirms spin-up. remember to update routing policy: `region_preference: eu-west1 -> fallback: us-west2` in the canary config.
jamie: will update the routing policy and post the canary config diff. quick config snippet i'll push to PR:
jamie: ```yaml
canary_routes:
  - name: inference-canary
    regions: ["eu-west1"]
    fallback_regions: ["us-west2"]
    min_headroom: 0.12
    max_rps: 40
```
liu: also suggest temp change to batching: lower `max_batch_size` from 128 -> 64 for the next 2 hours to reduce memory spikes. i can open the change now if everyone is okay.
rita: ok from me, go ahead. i'll coordinate the capacity ticket and mark it high-priority.
jamie: thanks — i'll open the ticket (CR-4521) and @marco please watch autoscaler logs while i roll the batching change. i'll post the PR link after it's up. :thumbsup:
